name: Proxmox_VE_Node_Network
description: State of this Proxmox VE node's bridges, bonds, physical ports and VLAN interfaces, asked of the node itself.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript: one /nodes/{node}/network call to this node per interval; any API token may read it.

One instance per interface Proxmox manages of these types: bridge, bond, eth, vlan, and the Open vSwitch OVSBridge, OVSBond, OVSPort and OVSIntPort. Loopback is left out. The wildvalue is the interface name.

Active is Proxmox's own flag. Healthy is 0 only for an interface set to start at boot (autostart) that is not active -- a bridge whose guests have lost their network, or a bond member that is down -- so an unused port is not an alert. Ports counts a bridge's ports or a bond's members.

Proxmox gives no interface MAC address or link speed in this endpoint, and no CDP or LLDP neighbours, so the link from a node's ports to the physical switch is drawn, as for any server, by the switch's own topology where the switch is monitored.

Each instance carries a topology vertex for Proxmox_VE_Cluster_Topology (predef.externalResourceID and predef.externalResourceType). The keys are written plain, so where topo.namespace or topo.blacklist is set, which rewrites the TopologySource's keys, discovery stamps none: the instances stay, off the map. The vertex is VirtualSwitch for a bridge, PhysicalNIC for a port or bond and NICVIRTUAL for a VLAN interface, drawn between the node and the guests on it.

Applies on ProxmoxVE_Node resources the NetScan has not marked unreachable (pve.netscan.reachable). The node is asked directly, at this resource's own hostname, and never through another node: another node would answer for itself. The suite has no addCategory_* PropertySource: the NetScan sets the categories and pve.cluster.role, and the product page lists them for a resource added by hand.

datapoints.name: Active
datapoints.description: 1 when Proxmox reports the interface active.

datapoints.name: Healthy
datapoints.description: 0 when the interface is set to start at boot but is not active; 1 otherwise.
datapoints.alertBody:
Network interface ##INSTANCE## on ##HOST## is set to start at boot but is not active. Guests on a bridge that is down have no network.

Status: ##ALERTVALUEDISPLAYSTATUSNAME## (##VALUE##).

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: Ports
datapoints.description: Bridges and bonds only: the number of ports or bond members configured.
